description.value: A free BC Hydro reservoir campground beside Jones Lake in the mountains above Chilliwack, with washrooms on site; access is via a gravel forest service road that will be rough for loaded touring bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Hydro website fetch returned only site navigation menus with no campsite-specific content, so OSM tags are the primary evidence source. OSM explicitly confirms tents=yes, toilets=yes, picnic_table=yes, and explicitly negates drinking=no, shower=no, washing_machine=no, reservation=no, internet_access=no, fee=no. No phone, address, or cycling-specific amenity data is available from either source.
concerns: BC Hydro website fetch returned only generic site navigation content; no campsite-specific details (facilities, access notes, seasonal info) were captured. OSM tags are the sole amenity evidence source.
No potable water on site (OSM: drinking=no) — a significant limitation for touring cyclists that should be highlighted in any listing.
No address or phone number available in OSM or website content.

Alt name in OSM is 'Jones Lake East Recreation Area' — may indicate this record covers one of multiple distinct camping areas at Jones Lake; worth verifying whether separate OSM records exist for other areas.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, free, open-access BC Hydro campsite with tents permitted and toilets on site — a practical and no-cost overnight option for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack/Fraser Valley corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Leashed dogs permitted per OSM (dog=leashed). No fee per OSM (fee=no). Motor vehicle access confirmed (motor_vehicle=yes). Caravans also permitted (caravans=yes).

wow_evidence: access is via a gravel forest service road that will be rough for loaded touring bikes
